v3_bug_summary.introduced_in: V3 (12h supervisor) — when generalizing from V2 6h supervisor
v3_bug_summary.severity: high — raw FINAL_VERDICT corrupted on every stage (6h/12h/24h/48h/72h/7d)
v3_bug_summary.symptom: raw FINAL_VERDICT.json status=FAIL with default-zeros row counts even when the actual data is good; corrected verdict required to disambiguate
v3_bug_summary.trigger: Post-stage Python block (line 361, 471, 494) interpolates bash ${REAL_GATE_PASS} (lowercase 'true'/'false') directly into Python dict values and ternary expressions. Python interprets these as bare names, raising NameError. The post-stage python block exits with rc=1, fail-safe trap writes default-zeros FINAL_VERDICT (status=FAIL, pool_snapshot_rows=0, etc.).
v3_bug_summary.fix: All 4 Python heredocs (trap, aggregate, finalize, fallback) converted to quoted form (<<'PYEOF_...'). Bash values exported as environment variables. Python reads os.environ (integers + strings only) and computes boolean comparisons in Python with proper bool type. aggregate_summary.json now writes a real JSON bool. Finalize + fallback read it via json.loads.

scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_167_172_trap_setup: Added comment explaining trap is a fail-safe and does not depend on aggregate_summary.json.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_180_183_trap_env_exports: Added export TRAP_REPORT_DIR / TRAP_ELAPSED_MIN_TRAP / TRAP_DURATION_HOURS / TRAP_TOLERANCE_MIN / TRAP_STAGE_NAME / TRAP_RUN_ID / TRAP_SESSION / TRAP_SIGNAL / TRAP_RC for trap block.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_184_232_trap_body: Python block rewritten: reads os.environ values; computes runtime_valid = elapsed_min_trap >= (duration_hours * 60 - tolerance_min); no bash boolean interpolation.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_316_323_gate_decision: (unchanged) Sets REAL_GATE_PASS and GATE_DECISION bash vars. Note: REAL_GATE_PASS is no longer used in any Python heredoc — it is preserved only for the bash log line and the gate check. GATE_DECISION is exported as env var for aggregate block.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_325_330_aggregate_env_exports: Added export DATA_DIR LOG_DIR STAGE_NAME RUN_ID LOOP_COUNT SLEEP_SECONDS ELAPSED_MIN DURATION_HOURS TOLERANCE_MIN GATE_DECISION REPORT_DIR SESSION before aggregate python invocation.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_341_415_aggregate_block: Changed python3 <<PYEOF → python3 <<'PYEOF_AGG' (quoted). Body rewritten: reads os.environ, computes runtime_valid in Python, writes aggregate_summary.json with real JSON bool for actual_runtime_valid_for_<STAGE>_gate.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_431_497_finalize_block: Changed python3 <<PYEOF → python3 <<'PYEOF_FINAL' (quoted). Body rewritten: reads aggregate_summary.json via json.loads (proper bool), computes status / data_quality / recommended_next_stage in Python, writes FINAL_VERDICT.json.
scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_sta.line_505_569_fallback_block: Changed python3 - <<PYEOF_FALLBACK → python3 - <<'PYEOF_FALLBACK' (quoted). Body rewritten: reads aggregate_summary.json via json.loads; falls back to ELAPSED_MIN/DURATION_HOURS/TOLERANCE_MIN env vars if JSON missing; runtime_valid is a real Python bool. Writes CORRECTED_FINAL_VERDICT_FALLBACK.json.
